description: Implementation of kernel heap management functions for Zephyr RTOS, including heap initialization, aligned allocation, general allocation, and freeing, with support for demand paging and multithreading.

methods.name: k_heap_init
methods.description: Initializes a kernel heap structure with provided memory and size.

methods.name: k_heap_aligned_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory from the heap with specified alignment and timeout.

methods.name: k_heap_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory from the heap with default alignment and specified timeout.

methods.name: k_heap_free
methods.description: Frees previously allocated memory back to the heap.
